attributes.title: AACD 2027
attributes.venue: Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
AACD 2027, the scientific session of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, runs March 31 to April 3, 2027 at the Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort in Hollywood, Florida. The program centers on esthetic and restorative dentistry and mixes general sessions, hands-on workshops and exhibitor events.

Attendance is limited to AACD members: the conference site states that you must be an AACD member to register. Course selection opens in two waves, on November 30, 2026 for PRIME (early) registrants and on December 7, 2026 for everyone else. Tuition covers breakfasts Thursday through Saturday, lunches on Thursday and Friday, the welcome reception and exhibitor socials.

The organizer had not yet posted fees or the CE credit statement when we checked. Confirm credit hours and the cancellation policy on the official site before you book travel.
